entries.03e7ccfed8fc49a6: In Asia, this business provides temporary staffing, placement, outsourcing and HR and labor consulting services, among others, in accordance with the laws of each country. In Australia and New Zealand, it dispatches and places staff and engineers for mining and manufacturing clients and provides training programs. Its relationships with companies and workers are broadly the same as those of temporary staffing in the Japan Staffing SBU, BPO in the BPO SBU and placement in the Career SBU.

entries.21412c2a465bfe65: Established in October 2008 as a [[term:holding-company|holding company]] that wholly owns Tempstaff Co., Ltd. and People Staff Co., Ltd., through the management integration of those two companies (its name at the time was Temp Holdings Co., Ltd., changed to its current name in July 2017). The group vision is 'Let's work and smile.' As of March 31, 2026, the company, 154 consolidated subsidiaries and five affiliates operate across five SBUs (Strategic Business Units) and 'Others'. Consolidated employees number 74,926.

entries.363d315d462d086a: This business provides temporary staffing across a wide range of industries in Japan, centered on office work. From dispatch staff recruited and registered in advance, it selects and dispatches people whose preferences match the conditions of the client company. Group companies enter into employment contracts with staff and pay their wages, while they enter into dispatch contracts with client companies, and staff work under the direction and supervision of the client company. It also provides talent placement services, centered on office positions. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥599,592 million (up 3.3% year on year), the largest of the 5 reportable [[term:segment|segments]]. The increase in revenue is attributed to a 1.8% year-on-year rise in the number of dispatched workers and a 2.2% increase in billing rates.
entries.3a24c07519220f40: This business performs system development, infrastructure design, and evaluation and verification, mainly in the IT, internet and EC fields. It also accepts outsourced software and mechanism design for audio-visual equipment and information and communication equipment, and the development and design of electric circuits, and provides business process consulting, cloud services and more to client companies. It rests on contracted projects and the dispatch of its employee engineers.

entries.4271d95f5649c4de: This is a job media platform operated in-house that carries job advertisements from companies recruiting regular employees.
entries.4ee3703cf5f2c33a: This business provides BPO (business process outsourcing) and consulting, undertaking the operations of companies and government agencies as an external specialist firm.
entries.51067f9a2d7c4a5b: This is an overseas business operating in Asia, including Singapore and Malaysia, as well as in Australia and New Zealand, spanning 13 countries and regions. In Asia, its mainstays are staffing services; in Australia and New Zealand, they are staffing services and facilities management, which handles the management and maintenance of facilities. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥496,354 million (up 4.3% year on year), the 2nd largest of the 5 reportable [[term:segment|segments]]. The increase in revenue was mainly due to strong performance in the facilities management business.
entries.54d4bf0fce48172a: BPO (contracted business operations) and consulting (BPO Business, CX Business and Professional Business)
entries.5a97b22258754338: As the source of its competitive advantage, it cites its unique assets: a vast amount of personal data and strong brand power, as well as diverse ways of working, such as dispatch, recruitment and short-term gap-filling jobs. Based on the value of human intermediation that stays close to individuals and companies, it plans to combine 'proprietary data', such as customers' behavioral data and employees' skills and know-how behavioral data, with the use of AI. In the BPO SBU, it cites 'process design capability and organizational and personnel management capability' as its strengths, combined with technology.
entries.6672b6b96a6250e7: Temporary staffing (mainly clerical) and placement services focused on clerical positions
entries.6902f8aa9f204031: This business supports mid-career hiring of regular employees by client companies, operating placement and job media centered on its flagship brand 'doda'. It improves marketing efficiency by leveraging brand strength. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥150,495 million (up 5.7% year on year), and it is the 3rd largest of the 5 reportable [[term:segment|segments]]. Even as client companies narrowed their hiring and job seekers remained cautious, demand for job openings stayed firm, with particularly strong performance in placement for high-end talent and comprehensive support services for the use of professional talent.
entries.6dc62f36403f2ba0: This business supports mid-career hiring of regular employees by client companies, operating placement and job media centered on its flagship brand 'doda'.
entries.6e04ff609399f4d2: A business that, as a group of IT and engineering specialists and technicians, provides design and development outsourcing and engineer dispatch.
entries.6f9fc7cbf77d2a39: In the automotive, commercial vehicle, home appliance and aerospace equipment fields, this business is engaged in specialized technology development, including mechanical design, electrical and electronic design, control software design and experimental certification services. It supports the entire process from product planning and concept through design and development to prototyping, evaluation and testing, with a structure suited to the content and scale of each project, and receives research and development outsourcing contracts. It operates on project outsourcing and the dispatch of its employed engineers.
entries.7142a68720837477: Manufacturers in the automotive, home appliance and aerospace-related fields, among others
entries.71fe28da7d6a85c9: This category groups together the group's division that explores future businesses and companies providing specialized services. It is a business segment not included in the reportable [[term:segment|segments]], and in addition to businesses relating to the group as a whole, it provides education and training, businesses related to people with disabilities, digital solutions for recruitment and personnel management, and creates new businesses through an incubation program. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥60,363 million. Following an intra-group reorganization effective April 1, 2025, part of the Staffing business has been moved here.

entries.8b7ddfd18deb1e34: In May 2026, the company announced its three-year 'Medium-Term Management Plan FY2028', with the fiscal year ending March 2027 as its first year. Under the management direction 'Toward a technology-driven human resources services company' and with 'AI-driven improvement of profitability and business model transformation' as its basic policy, it aims for high growth and high profitability over the medium to long term. It positions the Career SBU and Technology SBU as 'growth markets', and the Staffing SBU, BPO SBU and Asia Pacific SBU as 'foundation markets'; in growth markets, it aims for transformation through the implementation of AI models and a shift to high value-added areas. The Asia Pacific SBU gives priority to optimizing its business portfolio, while the R&D Function Unit and Gojob's new areas consolidate their focus into the Frontline Worker area, which refers to job types at the front line of the workplace.
entries.9365068b4f0a5319: This business uses a group of IT and engineering specialists and engineers to provide outsourced design and development work and engineer dispatch. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥113,632 million (up 9.3% from the previous year), the 5th of the 5 reportable [[term:segment|segments]]. Continued stronger engineer hiring increased the number of engineers in operation, and both the IT/DX Solutions Business and the Engineering Business grew in revenue.

It broadly recruits job seekers who wish to be directly employed by companies and introduces them to hiring companies by matching the hiring companies' conditions (job content, required experience and abilities, and employment terms) with each person's wishes. When both parties agree and an employment contract is concluded after interviews and other steps, it receives an introduction fee from the hiring company.

In dispatch, the company group enters into employment contracts with registered dispatch staff and pays their wages, and it enters into dispatch contracts with client companies, under which the staff work under the direction of the client companies. In recruitment and job-posting media, both client companies seeking to hire permanent employees and job seekers wishing to be directly employed by companies use the services.

entries.c8fcf23f1f15f79f: Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 ([[term:ifrs|IFRS]]) was ¥1,555,833 million (up 7.2% year on year), and revenue increased in every SBU. Revenue from external customers was ¥599,592 million for Staffing, ¥496,354 million for Asia Pacific, ¥150,495 million for Career, ¥135,391 million for BPO, ¥113,632 million for Technology, and ¥60,363 million for 'Others', which is not included in the reportable segments. In Staffing, the number of dispatched workers rose 1.8% year on year and the billing unit price rose 2.2%; in BPO, revenue from PERSOL Communication Services Co., Ltd., acquired in February 2025, was added. Referral fees are received when an employment contract is concluded, and job-posting fees are received when the advertisement is published.
entries.cf42c491b3ef1579: Fees for temporary staffing (based on dispatch contracts with client companies; the increase in the number of dispatched workers and billing rates is cited as a factor in higher revenue)
entries.d1cfbf340a08310c: This business provides consistent services from strategy formulation through implementation support to effect verification. It provides business reform and DX support across a wide range of operations, including sales, HR, general affairs and accounting, and support for introducing and using RPA and AI and for developing digital talent.
entries.d4b2e5df4a7cb102: This business sits between client companies and their customers and provides services using data and technology. It undertakes inbound and outbound customer handling combining phone, email and chat, as well as customer support and IT help desk services.

entries.d9ef4616d7cd5571: Profit attributable to owners of the parent for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥42,688 million (up 19.0% year on year). The group's main working capital needs are payments of wages to dispatched staff and employees, and short-term working capital is based on its own funds generated from operations. For large-scale funding needs such as corporate acquisitions, the company's policy is to use the most suitable means, such as bank borrowings and bond issues; in October 2025, it acquired 85% of the issued shares of Gojob SAS, which operates an AI-driven staffing platform business in France.

entries.deb4ea8f5cfd2d6a: In Japan, the company provides staffing mainly for clerical work (Staffing SBU), BPO and consulting that undertake client companies' operations (BPO SBU), design and development contracting and engineer dispatch in the IT and engineering fields (Technology SBU), and recruitment services and the job-posting media 'doda', which support mid-career hiring of permanent employees (Career SBU). In Asia, it provides human resources services, and in Australia and New Zealand, it provides human resources services and facilities management, which involves the management and maintenance of facilities (Asia Pacific SBU). In 'Others', it explores new businesses and provides specialized services such as education and training and support for the employment of persons with disabilities.

The operations it undertakes are wide-ranging, from clerical work such as reception and order processing for private companies, payroll calculation, data entry, and IT work such as telemarketing and technical support, to general counter services for local governments. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥135,391 million (up 24.3% year on year), and it is the 4th largest of the 5 reportable [[term:segment|segments]], but it has the highest growth rate. The revenue increase includes revenue of ¥23,214 million (¥4,053 million in the prior fiscal year) from PERSOL Communication Services Co., Ltd. (formerly Fujitsu Communication Services Co., Ltd.), acquired in February 2025.
